LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.3: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing in Grade 9 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can writing fluency be enhanced?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. fill in the word puzzle with the appropriate names of pets, farms, and wild animals collaboratively,

2. complete the sentences on pets, farm, and wild animals with the correct words and phrases collaboratively,

3. match descriptions of animals to corresponding pictures with peers,

4. use the pictures provided to write short descriptions of the animals in terms of their physical appearance, size, and characters (e.g. 我小狗的 眼睛很大,牙齿很白。),

5. describe their favourite animal/pet and combine their writing with visual arts to create mixed media displays,

6. present their artworks on a gallery wall for peer mentorship and feedback,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. fill in the word puzzle with the appropriate names of pets, farms, and wild animals collaboratively,
2. complete the sentences on pets, farm, and wild animals with the correct words and phrases collaboratively,
3. match descriptions of animals to corresponding pictures with peers,
4. use the pictures provided to write short descriptions of the animals in terms of their physical appearance, size, and characters (e.g. 我小狗的 眼睛很大,牙齿很白。),
5. describe their favourite animal/pet and combine their writing with visual arts to create mixed media displays,
6. present their artworks on a gallery wall for peer mentorship and feedback,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: the learner works collaboratively with peers to complete the given sentences with the correct words and

phrases.

• Communication and Collaboration: teamwork skills are enhanced when the learner participates actively in the gallery walk

to get the views of their peers on their presentations.

Values:
Respect: the learner appreciates the diverse opinions of their peers when they brainstorm and share their perspectives on the

value of animals in the community.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Human-wildlife conflict: the learner develops an awareness of the importance of the peaceful coexistence of humans and animals

in society.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the skills used in expressing their creativity using visual art displays to Creative Arts and Sports.
